description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader to oversee all aspects of facility operations, ensuring exceptional patient care, regulatory compliance, and financial stability. You will play a pivotal role in fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.

This position offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and the success of the facility. If you are a results-oriented administrator with a passion for quality healthcare, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong leadership, operational, and financial management skills
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Med-Peds Physician to join a thriving community health center in Greenville, SC. This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care within a supportive environment.

This role offers a highly competitive compensation package, including a base salary of $210,000+, a guaranteed $25,000 bonus, and an additional $25,000 in potential bonuses. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is available on payday one for eligible candidates. Enjoy great benefits, generous paid time off, and a recently revamped compensation and raise structure designed to reward your expertise.
salaryShort: $210,000+ per year + up to $50,000 in bonuses
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board certification or eligibility in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Med-Peds
Ability to obtain or hold a valid medical license in South Carolina
salaryOrBonusInfo: The compensation package includes a non-negotiable base salary of $210,000+, a guaranteed $25,000 bonus, and an additional $25,000 in potential bonuses. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is available on payday one with a signed promissory note. This revamped compensation structure is highly competitive, exceeding the average for family physicians in South Carolina.
